scope: 1970 original Let It Be album performance, 4:03 version

recordingBinding.recordingEdition: 1970 original Let It Be album performance, 4:03 version
recordingBinding.notes: Genius record 1575 identifies the original album and its 8 May 1970 release. The artist catalog distinguishes the 4:03 album performance from the 3:50 single. Current Apple track 1441164738 is a corroborating 4:03 album reissue, not the retired linked track 401151904. Performance-level binding only; no ISRC or bit-identical mix/master claim.

independentSources.role: Primary harmonic analysis by Alan W. Pollack
independentSources.finding: Labels the global key C major, names Let It Be CD track 6 and the Past Masters single, and analyzes the C-centered intro, verses, refrain and coda. The detailed reference uses the Get Back mix of the same Take 27 and explicitly contrasts official album/single overdubs. This supports the performance-level tonic, not exact mastering identity.
PVG edition MN0053244 lists C major as original published key. Arrangement metadata corroborates the independent harmonic analysis; it is not standalone recording proof.

catalogCrosscheck.dateCaveat: Current Apple track release date uses March 6 (the earlier single date); album name and 4:03 duration corroborate the album performance. The official artist catalog and resolved Genius album date supply the May 8 scope.

verificationDecision: Independent musical analysis identifies global C major for the original album performance. The analysis also distinguishes the single and Get Back mixes; their identity is not asserted to be bit-identical. No exact bitmaster, full lyric or chord-placement accuracy is certified.
